text: Conrad Algarve is on the edge of the Quinta do Lago estate near Almancil, in the area golfers call the Golden Triangle, so some of the Algarve's best-known courses are a few minutes' drive away. [Quinta do Lago North](/courses/quinta-do-lago-north) and [South](/courses/quinta-do-lago-south) are about 6 minutes from the hotel, [Pinheiros Altos](/courses/pinheiros-altos) about 7, the two [Vale do Lobo](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal) courses about 8 and [Laranjal](/courses/quinta-do-lago-laranjal) about 10. The hotel has no course of its own, but Quinta do Lago sells golf packages for Conrad guests that include transfers to its courses. **Last checked: November 2026.**

The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer. Each course page has the full table for every tee.

**[Quinta do Lago South](/courses/quinta-do-lago-south)** (par 72, 6,500 m, slope 139): the championship course, which has hosted the Portuguese Open eight times. Rolling fairways, with a buggy optional. A buggy isn't included in the standard green fee.

**[Quinta do Lago North](/courses/quinta-do-lago-north)** (par 72, 6,140 m, slope 133): redesigned in 2014 by Beau Welling with Paul McGinley and a little more forgiving than the South, but hillier, so a buggy is a good idea.

**[Quinta do Lago Laranjal](/courses/quinta-do-lago-laranjal)** (par 72, 6,480 m, slope 136): opened in 2009 on a former orange grove, with its own clubhouse. Flat and easy to walk, but open to the wind.

**[Pinheiros Altos](/courses/pinheiros-altos)** (27 holes, slope up to 141): three nines, Pines, Corks and Olives, played in different pairs. The Olives nine is flat and the other two are more undulating. It has the highest slope of the courses nearest the hotel, and the lowest green fees.

**[Vale do Lobo Royal](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal)** (par 72, 6,005 m, slope 133): home of the famous par-3 16th, played across a ravine towards the beach. See the [Royal scorecard](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal/scorecard) and [hole-by-hole guide](/courses/vale-do-lobo-royal/hole-by-hole).

**[Vale do Lobo Ocean](/courses/vale-do-lobo-ocean)** (par 73, 6,122 m, slope 140): the original Henry Cotton course from 1968, hillier than the Royal, with a buggy advised. See the [Ocean hole-by-hole guide](/courses/vale-do-lobo-ocean/hole-by-hole).
Golf at Conrad Algarve

Conrad Algarve is one of Quinta do Lago's two partner hotels, and it has a **golf concierge** who can book your rounds, as well as lessons with the hotel's PGA-qualified professional. Breakfast starts at 7am, which suits an early tee time.
Quinta do Lago itself sells golf packages at Conrad. These are the two listed on its website in November 2026:

**Signature Quinta do Lago Golf Experience:** three nights at Conrad from €1,627 for two people sharing, with two rounds on the Quinta do Lago courses, a shared buggy or electric trolley, two days of range balls to warm up, **free transfers between the hotel and the courses**, 10% off at the hotel's restaurants and bars and one dinner. There are also 5- and 7-night versions, and prices change with the season.

**Stay, Play & Perfect Your Game:** three nights from €1,361 per person sharing a Deluxe Twin Room, with three rounds at Quinta do Lago, a shared buggy or trolley, free golf transfers for two or more players, a golf fitness class, a short-game lesson and three dinners.

See the [Quinta do Lago special offers page](https://www.quintadolago.com/en/special-offers/) for the current packages. If you book the hotel and the golf separately, compare the cost: Quinta do Lago's standard green fees alone run from €170 to €264 a round, and a buggy isn't included.

**For a change of scene,** the four Vilamoura courses and Vila Sol are 20 to 25 minutes away. Laguna and Millennium are among the cheapest rounds in the area, from €88. See [the cheapest golf in Vilamoura](/guide/cheapest-golf-in-vilamoura).
Getting there

Conrad Algarve is about **25 minutes and 16 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. Our guide to [Faro Airport to Quinta do Lago and Vale do Lobo with golf clubs](/guide/faro-airport-to-quinta-do-lago-vale-do-lobo-with-golf-clubs) compares taxis, transfers and car hire. If you'd rather not fly with your clubs, see [hiring golf clubs at Faro Airport](/guide/hiring-golf-clubs-at-faro-airport).
For other places to stay in the area, see [hotels near Quinta do Lago golf](/guide/hotels-near-quinta-do-lago-golf) and [hotels near Vale do Lobo golf](/guide/hotels-near-vale-do-lobo-golf).
Golf near Conrad Algarve: common questions
Does Conrad Algarve have its own golf course?
No. It's a partner hotel of Quinta do Lago, whose North and South courses are about 6 minutes away by car, and Laranjal about 10.
What is the closest golf course to Conrad Algarve?
Quinta do Lago North and South, about 6 minutes away, followed by Pinheiros Altos at about 7 minutes and the two Vale do Lobo courses at about 8.
Does Conrad Algarve offer golf transfers?

Quinta do Lago's golf packages at Conrad include free transfers between the hotel and the Quinta do Lago courses (for two or more players on the Stay, Play & Perfect Your Game package). If you book golf separately, ask the hotel's golf concierge.
Do I need a handicap to play near Conrad Algarve?

Yes, at all the nearby 18-hole courses: they ask for a handicap certificate of up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
